items.source: useDefaultFilters - whether to register the default filters for the @Component, @Repository, @Service, and @Controller stereotype annotations
items.translation: useDefaultFilters - 是否要为 @Component、@Repository、@Service 和 @Controller 立体注解注册默认过滤器

items.source: environment - the Environment to use
items.translation: environment - 要使用的环境

items.source: This will implicitly register all annotations that have the @Component meta-annotation including the @Repository, @Service, and @Controller stereotype annotations.
items.translation: 这将隐式注册所有带有 `@Component` 元注解的注解，包括 `@Repository`、`@Service` 和 `@Controller` 立体注解。

items.source: Candidate components are identified by applying exclude and include filters. AnnotationTypeFilter and AssignableTypeFilter include filters for an annotation/target-type that is annotated with Indexed are supported: if any other include filter is specified, the index is ignored and classpath scanning is used instead.
items.translation: 候选组件通过应用排除和包含过滤器来识别。支持对带有 Indexed 注解的注解/目标类型使用 AnnotationTypeFilter 和 AssignableTypeFilter 包含过滤器：如果指定了任何其他包含过滤器，则忽略索引并改用类路径扫描。

items.source: This implementation is based on Spring's MetadataReader facility, backed by an ASM ClassReader.
items.translation: 此实现基于 Spring 的MetadataReader设施，并由 ASM 的ClassReader提供支持。

items.source: Default is a CachingMetadataReaderFactory for the specified resource loader.
items.translation: 默认情况下，为指定的 资源加载器 使用 CachingMetadataReaderFactory。

items.source: Call this setter method after setResourceLoader(ResourceLoader) in order for the given MetadataReaderFactory to override the default factory.
items.translation: 在调用此 Setter 方法之前，必须先调用setResourceLoader(ResourceLoader)，以便给定的 MetadataReaderFactory 能够覆盖默认工厂。

items.source: Default is a PathMatchingResourcePatternResolver, also capable of resource pattern resolving through the ResourcePatternResolver interface.
items.translation: 默认是一个 `PathMatchingResourcePatternResolver`，也具备通过 `ResourcePatternResolver` 接口进行资源模式解析的能力。

items.source: The default implementation checks whether the class is not dependent on an enclosing class as well as whether the class is either concrete (and therefore not an interface) or has @Lookup methods.
items.translation: 默认实现会检查该类是否不依赖于外部类，以及该类是否为具体类（因此不是接口）或具有 @Lookup 方法。

items.source: Also supports JSR-330's Named annotation if available.
items.translation: 同时也支持可用的 JSR-330 的Named注解。

items.source:
The default implementation resolves placeholders against system properties,
and converts a "."-based package path to a "/"-based resource path.
items.translation: 默认实现将占位符解析为系统属性，并将基于"."的包路径转换为基于"/"的资源路径。

items.source: Add an include type filter to the end of the inclusion list.
items.translation: 在包含列表的末尾添加一个包含类型过滤器。

items.source: Protected constructor for flexible subclass initialization.
items.translation: 受保护的构造函数，用于灵活的子类初始化。

items.source: Clear the local metadata cache, if any, removing all cached class metadata.
items.translation: 清除本地元数据缓存（如有），删除所有缓存的类元数据。

items.source: Scan the component index or class path for candidate components.
items.translation: 扫描组件索引或类路径以查找候选组件。

items.source: Return the MetadataReaderFactory used by this component provider.
items.translation: 返回此组件提供者使用的 MetadataReaderFactory。

items.translation: 返回该组件提供者使用的 ResourceLoader。

items.source:
Determine whether the given class does not match any exclude filter
and does match at least one include filter.
items.translation: 确定给定类是否不匹配任何排除过滤器且至少匹配一个包含过滤器。

items.source: Reset the configured type filters.
items.translation: 重置已配置的类型过滤器。

items.source:
System property that instructs Spring to ignore class format exceptions during
classpath scanning, in particular for unsupported class file versions.
By default, such a class format mismatch leads to a classpath scanning failure.
items.translation: 指示 Spring 在类路径扫描期间忽略类格式异常的系统属性，特别是针对不支持的类文件版本。默认情况下，此类类格式不匹配会导致类路径扫描失败。

items.source:
Set the resource pattern to use when scanning the classpath.
This value will be appended to each base package name.
items.translation: 设置扫描类路径时使用的资源模式。此值将附加到每个基础包名之后。
